title: The House of the Ninth Floor
author: Jonah Pemberton
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
